# Sachit — Developer Portfolio Summary

> Machine-readable summary of portfolio sections, selected projects, and technical focus.
> Author: Sachit
> Portfolio: https://sachin-portfoli.vercel.app/
> GitHub: https://github.com/sachit1751-art
> Contact: sachit1751@gmail.com

## Overview

Sachit is an independent developer building web applications, Android apps, and practical AI integrations. The main focus is React, TypeScript, Next.js, and product-oriented full-stack development, with additional Android project experience.

## Currently Building

### OutreachOS
- **Status:** In development; generated code still needs local setup, runtime checks, and workflow validation.
- **Purpose:** Personal CRM for startup research, contacts, outreach history, and follow-up tracking.
- **Note:** Not yet presented as production-ready.

## Selected Projects

### Community Management Platform
- **Category:** Full-stack web application
- **Technologies:** React, TypeScript, Vite, Supabase, PostgreSQL, SQL, Edge Functions
- **Summary:** Community platform focused on resident communication, announcements, chat, and role-aware access. The source repository is private.

### SKY ROMs
- **Category:** Web platform
- **Live demo:** https://sky-roms.vercel.app/
- **Source:** https://github.com/sachit1751-art/SKY-website-v2
- **Technologies:** React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Express, Supabase integration support
- **Summary:** Browse Android custom ROM information with search, filtering, device details, interactive guides, community feedback, and an administrative interface. Check the repository for the current backend and storage configuration.

### MoneyPal
- **Category:** Native Android and Wear OS
- **Source:** https://github.com/sachit1751-art/MoneyPal
- **Technologies:** Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android SDK, Room Database, Wear OS
- **Summary:** Budget tracking app with expense entry, recurring expense tracking, local persistence, widgets, and a Wear OS companion.

### Audify
- **Category:** Native Android music player
- **Source:** https://github.com/sachit1751-art/Audify
- **Technologies:** Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android SDK, Hilt, Gradle
- **Summary:** Music player for discovering and organizing YouTube Music. The repository documents background playback, queue and playlist management, synced lyrics, audio controls, caching, and library features.

### ZNS Nexus
- **Category:** Interactive frontend
- **Source:** https://github.com/sachit1751-art/zns-nexuso
- **Technologies:** React, TypeScript, GSAP
- **Summary:** Motion-focused web experience with animated navigation, interactive cards, and scroll-driven transitions.

### Tic-Tac-Toe
- **Category:** Browser game
- **Technologies:** HTML, CSS, JavaScript, minimax
- **Summary:** Browser game with restart controls, difficulty options, win/draw detection, and a minimax-based opponent.

## Technical Focus

- **Web:** React, TypeScript, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS
- **Backend & data:** Node.js, Express, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Supabase
- **Android:** Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android SDK, Room, Wear OS
- **AI integrations:** LLM APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), JSON-RPC
- **Interactive UI:** Three.js, WebGL, GSAP

## Working Principles

1. Build usable software and iterate based on what breaks.
2. Prefer clear, maintainable implementations over unsupported claims.
3. Document setup and known limitations so reviewers can evaluate projects.
